entries.statement: StrategyLandscape and StrategicAlignment are read-only projections that mint no business identity and never remaster source facts.
Every referent is resolved to an authoritative base, declared-unallocated with a view-local placeholder, or blocked; placeholders are never promoted to model identifiers.

The closed alignment-basis allow-list is assessment, observation, or justified attributable expert judgment; expert judgment requires a named accountable party and recorded justification, otherwise no edge is stored and a finding is emitted.
Objective and portfolio remain distinct and a portfolio is never the satisfied objective.
Initiative or project output, outcome and benefit remain distinct; completion, spend, tags, budgets, status and membership prove none of them.
A causal edge remains a hypothesis until a method-bound WM-ACT-034 assessment records criteria, method, decision rule, evidence and determination.
A causal hypothesis cannot be promoted when its outcome or benefit referent is declared-unallocated or blocked; the determination stays on the WM-ACT-034 assessment.
Realized benefit requires final or amended qualified observations whose phenomenon time is inside the declared realization window plus adjudicated attribution.
Adjudicated attribution shares sum to at most one per benefit and period; portfolio and constituent claims never double-count.
Expected and realized states coexist; realization never overwrites expected history and confirmation never rewrites an earlier knowledge-time state.
Node and edge effective intervals, assertion knowledge time, and measurement phenomenon, result and ingestion times remain separate and non-collapsible.
Authoritative as-of, historical replay and scenario classes remain separate; scenario output never feeds authoritative actuals or benefit realization.
Missing measurement is coded absence rather than zero; late ingestion is not backdated into an earlier replay.
WM-XCT-025 is a value/unit/method/uncertainty mixin that requires a WM-MAT-008 observation host and creates no record identity.
Blocked referents remain visible and unenforceable, are never deleted or ranked authoritatively, and mark the view degraded.
Supporting and contradicting claims remain visible with provenance and are never netted.

A finding is a non-authoritative claim about a record, addressed to an owner resolved from the source master, and carries rule, subject, as-of time, evidence and severity; a recorded non-practicability justification with qualitative criteria is not a defect.
Released projections pin every input revision and policy choice and carry a reproducible fingerprint; changed pins create a new immutable issue.
